cards.text: Elijah the Tishbite is the man who told Ahab, king of Israel, there'd be no dew or rain except at his word (1 Kings 16:29; 17:1). Now, after a long time, in the third year of the drought, the word of the LORD comes to Elijah again.

cards.question: Three years into the drought, what does the LORD tell Elijah to do?

answers.text: Go and present himself to Ahab
Hide again by the Brook of Cherith
Stay on with the widow in Zarephath

cards.question: Along with sending Elijah to Ahab, the LORD makes a promise. He will send ___ upon the face of the earth.

cards.text: So Elijah heads out to face the king. Meanwhile, the famine is severe in Samaria.
And Ahab summons Obadiah, the man in charge of the palace. Remember that name, friend.

cards.question: Obadiah, the man in charge of Ahab's palace, greatly fears the LORD.

cards.text: When Jezebel, Ahab's wife, slaughtered the prophets of the LORD, Obadiah hid a hundred of them and gave them food and water (1 Kings 16:31). A HUNDRED prophets, friend, and I can't hide ONE cookie in my bakery without leaving a crumb trail.

cards.question: Obadiah hid those hundred prophets of the LORD fifty men per ___.

cards.text: Now Ahab gives Obadiah a job. Go throughout the land, to every spring and every valley.

cards.question: What is Ahab hoping to find at every spring and valley?

answers.text: Grass to keep the horses and mules alive
Grain to feed the hungry people of Samaria
Water to fill up the palace wells again

cards.text: So they divide the land to explore, and the hunt is on for one patch of green. I know that feeling, friend, because that's me every time a chocolate chip rolls under the oven.

cards.question: Once Ahab and Obadiah divide up the land, they search it together.

cards.text: Obadiah's out there on his own, checking springs and valleys. And SUDDENLY, there's Elijah, right in front of him.

cards.question: When Obadiah recognizes Elijah, he falls facedown.

cards.text: Obadiah asks, "Is it you, my lord Elijah?" Elijah's answer is simple, "It is I," and I bet he says it calm as a cookie cooling on the rack.

cards.question: Elijah tells Obadiah to keep his return a secret from Ahab.

cards.text: Elijah wants Obadiah to go tell Ahab, "Elijah is here!" Friend, I bet Obadiah's stomach just dropped straight into his sandals.

cards.question: What does Obadiah think Ahab will do to him if he delivers Elijah's message?

answers.text: Throw him out of the palace
Send him off to search more

cards.text: Obadiah explains: there's no nation or kingdom where Ahab hasn't sent someone to search for Elijah. Friend, I sat in a junk drawer for YEARS and nobody checked one cabinet for me.

cards.question: When a kingdom told Ahab's searchers that Elijah wasn't there, Ahab made that kingdom swear they hadn't found him.

cards.text: And NOW Elijah wants him to walk up to that king and say "Elijah is here!" Obadiah's got another worry, too.

cards.question: What does Obadiah worry will happen to Elijah once Obadiah leaves him?

answers.text: The Spirit of the LORD will carry him off
Ahab's searchers will catch up to him first
He will slip back into hiding by the brook

cards.text: Obadiah says if he tells Ahab and the king doesn't find Elijah, Ahab will kill him. But Obadiah says he has feared the LORD from his youth.
He reminds Elijah how he hid a hundred prophets of the LORD and gave them food and water. Then that line again: "He will kill me!"

cards.question: Elijah swears by the LORD of Hosts that he will present himself to Ahab ___.

cards.text: So Obadiah tells Ahab, and Ahab goes to meet Elijah. The king skips the hello and says, "Is that you, O troubler of Israel?"

cards.question: Ahab calls Elijah the troubler of Israel. Who does Elijah say has really troubled Israel?
Elijah says Ahab and his father's house have forsaken the ___ of the LORD and followed the ___.

cards.text: Then the man the king's been hunting everywhere starts giving the KING orders. Summon all Israel, Elijah says.

cards.question: Where does Elijah tell Ahab to summon all Israel to meet him?
Along with all Israel and the prophets of Asherah, Elijah wants Ahab to bring the prophets of ___ to Mount Carmel.

cards.text: He wants the four hundred and fifty prophets of Baal and the four hundred prophets of Asherah who eat at Jezebel's table, plus ONE Elijah. Pull up a chair, friend, because this story is NOT done.
